messages:
Emma (PM): FYI sales got a request from AcmeCorp asking for tenant-priority routing + rollback SLA if we miss their latency target. can we scope what to promise? :thinking:
Raj (Eng Lead): clarify ask: p95 target + capacity reservation?
Sophie (C-Success): they want p95 < 250ms and 99.9% uptime for routed requests; also credits on breach.
Emma (PM): rough proposal: (1) Priority-Soft: routing preference (best-effort) behind a feature flag (2) Priority-Reserved: paid dedicated pool with contractual SLOs + rollback policy.
Maria (SRE): technical note: Soft can't guarantee SLOs. Reserved requires pinned GPUs or quota; we can meet p95 but cost/ops increase.
Raj (Eng Lead): implementation options: a) flag + per-tenant token-bucket and routing tag b) dedicated per-tenant pool c) hybrid warm pool with dynamic spillover.
Oliver (Prod Ops): need clear failover triggers: e.g., sustained p95 > threshold for N minutes OR error-rate spike -> automatic spill to fallback. also canary ramp before full cutover.
Contracts Bot: suggested credit tiers: "10% credit for 1-hour breach"; "50% for full-day outage affecting >50% routed traffic".
Emma (PM): telemetry gates: p50/p95/p99, error rate, throughput, priority_spill_ratio, and traces to attribute time in priority path.
Maria (SRE): add distributed tracing markers and a pending-spill observable. eviction policy needed to shed load quickly.
Raj (Eng Lead): flag config sketch: {flag: "tenant_priority_v1", phases: [1%,10%,100%], fallback: "standard_route", kill_switch: "priority_disable_all"}. Canary health checks should watch p95+spill_ratio over 15m windows.
Oliver (Prod Ops): rollout playbook: 1) staging dry-run with synthetic load 2) internal 1% 3) beta 10% 4) opt-in customers 100% 5) ops handoff and automated escalation. each step gated by telemetry.
Sophie (C-Success): AcmeCorp wants 24/7 escalation available during 72h ramp. sales will want Soft at lower price — we need cost delta.
Raj (Eng Lead): timeline estimate: Soft prototype 2 sprints; token-bucket + telemetry 3 sprints; dedicated pool + billing/legal 6-8 sprints.
Emma (PM): negotiation points for contracts: distinguish "priority" (routing preference) vs "guarantee" (SLO); two SKUs; define credit formula and measurement windows.
Maria (SRE): risks: expectation mismatch, billing disputes, cascading backpressure. mitigations: shadow tests, explicit opt-in, SE signoff.
Oliver (Prod Ops): runbook tasks: create dashboard (Oliver), implement spill_ratio metric (Maria), flag prototype + kill-switch (Raj), pricing delta doc (Sophie).
Sophie (C-Success): I'll draft customer FAQ: what happens on degrade, credits, opt-out.
Contracts Bot: action: create contract appendix template for Priority features.
Emma (PM): decision: proceed with two-tier offer (Soft vs Reserved). present draft rollout + playbook next Wed. tagging @se-team. :wave:
Raj (Eng Lead): add a CI non-regression test that simulates spillover.
Maria (SRE): will smoke test tracing propagation.
Emma (PM): tentative internal dry-run date: 2026-04-15; I'll add calendar invite.
Oliver (Prod Ops): dashboard by EOD Friday.
Sophie (C-Success): will run pricing by sales when ready.
Emma (PM): closing thread — I'll open GH issues and attach notes. :lock:
